name: Google Tag Manager container scripts (gtm.js)
tier_rationale: Established company with published terms (A8): 'Google is trusted; terms open (public JavaScript).' (P061 chair rationale).

reliability.justification: Serves the container configuration exactly as the site owner published it; the ids it loads are facts about the container, not about who owns the sites that embed it (agencies reuse containers).

gtm_js.title: Google Tag Manager container script https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtm.js?id=GTM-XXXX (measurement ids configured in the container)

terms.quote: gtm_expand fetches https://www.googletagmanager.com/gtm.js?id=GTM-... from Google: disclosure third_party. [...] Google is trusted; terms open (public JavaScript).

gtm_js.notes: Quote: binding council text (P061 cond 1 and chair rationale). Research C0789 (verified_live 200, 2026-11-25/26). Google receives only the GTM container id, never the page or the target URL. Unknown containers also answer HTTP 200 with a generic ~242 KB runtime (no macros, no tags): 'not found' is decided from the content, never from the status (P061 cond 3). At most 5 containers per run, 1 MB cap, cache 7 days. Used by gtm_expand.

notes: Owned by batch p2-G03-1 (P061 gtm_expand). The gtag/js?id=G-... endpoint only echoes the measurement id (checked by the prep, not used). No published rate limit: polite pacing (1 s, one connection).
